answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 23791 Country: India Title: Hajj expense with my wife comes to rs.3.25 lacs. Can I Do hajj(with my wife) by managing fiannace as follows : Rs.1.50 lacs my saving Rs.1.00 lacs by sold out of jwellery of my wife Rs.0.75 lacs by borrowing from my friend(interest free) Is Hajj is Farz on me in above condition? Question: Hajj expense with my wife comes to rs.3.25 lacs. Can I Do hajj(with my wife) by managing fiannace as follows : Rs.1.50 lacs my saving Rs.1.00 lacs by sold out of jwellery of my wife Rs.0.75 lacs by borrowing from my friend(interest free) Is Hajj is Farz on me in above condition??? Mahmad asharaf-surat-Gujarat-India Answer ID: 23791 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1154/1154/M=1431) In the question mentioned above hajj is fardh on you. If your wife does not possess money from which she can bear the expenses of hajj with you, in this case, hajj is not fardh on your wife and it is not necessary for her to take debt. However, you can take her for hajj with you by taking debt if you want to take her for hajj and it is not difficult for you to pay the debt after returning from hajj. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
